description: Post-process an EXISTING rendered video (its served mp4 URL) with the proven direct-response 'reviewer' finish and/or a film-grain pass — no AI model, ~30s, billed for its compute only. pills=true composites a header pill (e.g. '10/10 would buy again'), a brand-accent sub-pill, and 3-4 green-check proof pills cascading in on the beat (YOU author the copy: header ≤40 chars, sub ≤34, each point ≤44 — concrete real benefits, never fabricated stats). grain=true applies a subtle camera-grain finish that makes photoreal AI renders look phone-shot ('less AI') — works alone or with pills. Returns a NEW video; the original is untouched.

accent.description: brand accent hex for the sub-pill

expected_credits.description: the get_cost price; refused unbilled if the live price differs

get_cost.description: true: return the price only; nothing runs or bills

header.description: header pill copy, ≤40 chars (required when pills is on)

idempotency_key.description: chosen once, resent unchanged on retries: the same key never buys twice

pills.description: default true — set false for a grain-only pass

sub.description: accent sub-pill copy, ≤34 chars (usually the product/brand)

videoUrl.description: the served URL of the video to finish (from a previous render/job); a URL, not a local file path; use upload_file for local files

name: finish_video
title: Finish video
